before.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load and aggregate the provided data
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
monthly = df.groupby('month', as_index=False)[['revenue', 'orders']].sum()

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))
axes[0].bar(monthly['month'], monthly['revenue'], color='steelblue')
axes[0].set_title('Total Revenue per Month')
axes[0].set_xlabel('Month')
axes[0].set_ylabel('Revenue')
axes[0].set_ylim(0, monthly['revenue'].max() * 1.1)
axes[0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=30)

axes[1].bar(monthly['month'], monthly['orders'], color='darkorange')
axes[1].set_title('Total Orders per Month')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Month')
axes[1].set_ylabel('Orders')
axes[1].set_ylim(0, monthly['orders'].max() * 1.1)
axes[1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=30)

fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
